ahad.name: Dua e Ahad

items.note: Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (‘a) is reported to have said, “Whoever prays Almighty Allah with this supplicatory prayer of covenant for forty mornings, will be one of the supporters of our Rising Imam. If he dies before that (i.e. the advent of the Imam), Almighty Allah will take him out of his grave and give him one thousand rewards for each word of this supplicatory prayer and erase from him one thousand of his wrongdoings.”
The supplicatory prayer is as follows:

items.en: O Allah the Lord of the Great Light,
the Lord of the Elevated Throne,
the Lord of the swollen ocean,

items.ar: وَ مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الزَّبُوْرِ
items.en: the Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms,
the Lord of shade and heat,
the Revealer of the Great Qur'an,
and the Lord of the Archangels,
the Prophets, and the Messengers:
O Allah, I beseech You in Your Noble Name,
in the Light of Your Luminous Face
and Your Eternal Kingdom.
O Ever-living! O Self-Subsistent!

items.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيۤ اَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْاَرَضُوْنَ
items.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name with which the heavens and the earth have lit up

items.ar: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ يَصْلَحُ بِهِ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ وَ الْاٰخِرُوْنَ
items.en: and in Your Name with which the past and the coming generations have become upright!
O He Who has been always alive before the existence of all living things!

items.ar: وَ يَا حَيًّا بَعْدَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ
items.en: O He Who shall be alive after the extinction of all living things!

items.ar: وَ يَا حَيًّا حِيْنَ لَا حَيَّ
items.en: O He Who has been always alive even when there was nothing else alive!

items.ar: يَا مُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰى وَ مُمِيْتَ الْاَحْيَاۤءِ
items.en: O He Who revives the dead ones and causes the living ones to die!

items.ar: يَا حَيُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ۔
items.en: O Ever-living! There is no god save You.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلَانَاالْاِمَامَ الْهَادِيَ الْمَهْدِيَّ الْقَاۤئِمَ بِاَمْرِكَ
items.en: O Allah, convey to our master Imam al-Mahdl, the guide who is to undertake Your orders,

items.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلٰىۤ اٰبَاۤئِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
items.en: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and upon his immaculate fathers,
on behalf of all of the believing men and women
in the east and west of the earth
and in plains, mountains,
lands, and seas,
and on behalf of my parents
(convey to him) blessings that are as weighty as Allah’s Throne,
as much as the ink of His Words,

items.ar: وَ مَاۤ اَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَ اَحَاطَ بِهِ كِتَابُهُ
items.en: and as many as that which is counted by His knowledge and encompassed by His Book.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيۤ اُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِيْ صَبِيْحَةِ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا
items.en: O Allah, I update to him in the beginning of this day
and throughout the days of lifetime a pledge,

items.ar: عَهْدًا وَ عَقْدًا وَ بَيْعَةً لَهُ فِيْ عُنُقِيْ
items.en: a covenant, and allegiance to which I commit myself

items.ar: لَاۤ اَحُوْلُ عَنْهَا وَ لَا اَزُوْلُ اَبَدًا
items.en: and from which I neither convert nor change.
O Allah, (please do) make me of his supporters,
sponsors, defenders,

items.ar: وَ الْمُسَارِعِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ قَضَاۤءِ حَوَاۤئِجِهِ
items.en: and those who hurry in carrying out his instructions,
those who comply with his orders,
those who uphold him,
those who precede others to implementing his will,
and those who will be martyred before him.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَهُ الْمَوْتُ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ عَلٰى عِبَادِكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا،
items.en: O Allah, if death that You have made inevitably and certainly incumbent upon Your servants stands between me and him,
then (please do) take me out of my grave using my shroud as dress,
unsheathing my sword,
holding my lance in my hand,

items.ar: مُلَبِّيًا دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِيْ فِي الْحَاضِرِ وَ الْبَادِيۤ
items.en: and responding to the call of the Caller who shall announce (his advent) in urban areas and deserts.
O Allah, (please do) show me his magnificent mien
and his praiseworthy forehead,

items.ar: وَ اكْحُلْ نَاظِرِيْ بِنَظْرَةٍ مِنِّيۤ اِلَيْهِ
items.en: delight my eyes by letting me have a look at him.
And (please) expedite his relief,
make his reappearance easy,
clear a spacious space for him,
guide me to follow his course,
give success to his issues,
and confirm his strength.
O Allah, construct Your lands through him
and refresh Your servants through him,
For You have said, and true are Your words:

items.ar: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ
items.en: “Corruption has appeared in the land and the sea
on account of what the hands of men have wrought.”
So, O Allah, (please) show us Your vicegerent,
the son of Your Prophet,
and the namesake of Your Messenger,

items.ar: حَتّٰى لَا يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ اِلَّا مَزَّقَهُ
items.en: so that he shall tear up any wrong item that he will face
and shall confirm and approve of the truth.

items.ar: وَ اجْعَلْهُ اللّٰهُمَّ مَفْزَعًا لِمَظْلُوْمِ عِبَادِكَ
items.en: O Allah, (please) make him the shelter to whom Your wronged servants shall resort,

items.ar: وَ نَاصِرًا لِمَنْ لَا يَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِرًا غَيْرَكَ
items.en: the supporter of those who cannot find any supporter save You,

items.ar: وَ مُجَدِّدًا لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ اَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ
items.en: the reviver of the laws of Your Book that have been suspended,

items.ar: وَ مُشَيِّدًا لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ اَعْلَامِ دِيْنِكَ وَ سُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ
items.en: and the constructor of all signs of Your religion and instructions of Your Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household, that he will see.

items.ar: وَ اجْعَلْهُ اَللّٰهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأْسِ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ
items.en: O Allah, (please) include him with those whom You protect from the domination of the aggressors.
O Allah, (please) delight Your Prophet Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,

items.ar: بِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ عَلٰى دَعْوَتِهِ
items.en: as well as all those who followed him in his promulgation by making (us) see him,
and (please) have mercy upon our humiliation after him.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ الْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ الْاُمَّةِ بِحُضُوْرِهِ
items.en: O Allah, (please) relieve this community from the (current) grief through presenting him
and expedite his advent for us:

items.ar: اِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيْدًا وَ نَرَاهُ قَرِيْبًا
items.en: “Surely, they think it to be far off, and We see it nigh.”
[do all that] In the name of Your mercy; O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

items.note: You may then pat your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following words:

items.ar: اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
items.en: (We pray for Your) earliest advent, earliest advent, O Patron of the Age.

waritha.name: Ziyarat e Waritha

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اٰدَمَ صَفْوَةِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the choice of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے آدم (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کے چنے ہوئے ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوْحٍ نَبِيِّ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the prophet of Allah.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے نوح (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کے نبی ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ خَلِيْلِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے ابراہیم (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کے خلیل ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوْسٰى كَلِيْمِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے موسٰی (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کے کلیم ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيْسٰى رُوْحِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے عیسٰی (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کی روح ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيْبِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the most beloved by Allah.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے محمد (ص) کے وارث جو خدا کے حبیب ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ [وَلِيِّ اللّٰهِ‏]
items.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے علی امیر المؤمنین (ع) کے وارث جو خدا کے ولی ہیں

items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of Muhammad the well-chosen Prophet.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے محمد مصطفٰی (ص) کے فرزند

items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of ‘Ali the well-pleased.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے علی مرتضٰی (ع) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاۤءِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the luminous lady.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے فاطمہ زہرا (س) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ خَدِيْجَةَ الْكُبْرٰى
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of Khadijah the grand lady.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے خدیجہ الکبرٰی (س) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ اللّٰهِ وَ ابْنَ ثَارِهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance,
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے وہ بزرگوار جس کے خون کا طالب خدا ہے، اور اس کے فرزند جس کے خون کا طالب خدا ہے

items.en: and the unavenged so far.
items.ur: اور جو مظلوم اور مصیبت زدہ ہوا

items.en: I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
items.ur: میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ آپ نے نماز قائم کی

items.en: defrayed the poor-rate,
items.ur: اور زکوٰۃ دی

items.en: enjoined the right,
items.ur: اور آپ نے نیک کاموں کا حکم دیا

items.en: forbade the wrong,
items.ur: اور برے کاموں سے منع فرمایا

items.ar: وَ اَطَعْتَ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُوْلَهُ حَتّٰى اَتَاكَ الْيَقِيْنُ
items.en: and obeyed Allah and His Messenger until death came upon you.
items.ur: یہاں تک کہ شہید ہو گئے

items.en: So, may Allah curse the people who slew you.
items.ur: پس خدا کی لعنت اس گروہ پر جس نے آپ کو قتل کیا

items.en: May Allah curse the people who persecuted you.
items.ur: اور خدا کی لعنت ہو اس گروہ پر جس نے آپ پر ظلم ڈھایا

items.ar: وَ لَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
items.en: May Allah curse the people who were pleased when they had heard of that.
items.ur: اور خدا کی لعنت ہو اس گروہ پر جس نے یہ واقعہ سنا تو وہ اس پر خوش ہوا

items.ar: يَا مَوْلَايَ يَاۤ اَبَا عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: O my Master, O Abu-‘Abdullah!
items.ur: اے میرے آقا اے ابو عبد اللہ (ع)

items.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوْرًا فِي الْاَصْلَابِ الشَّامِخَةِ
items.en: I bear witness that you were light in the sublime loins
items.ur: میں گواہی دیتا ہوں بے شک آپ وہ نور ہیں جو بلند مرتبہ صلبوں میں

items.en: and purified wombs;
items.ur: اور پاک و پاکیزہ رحموں میں منتقل ہوتا آیا

items.en: the impurities of the Ignorance Era could not object you to filth
items.ur: آپ زمانہ جاہلیت کی ناپاکیوں سے آلودہ نہ ہوئے

items.ar: وَ لَمْ تُلْبِسْكَ مِنْ مُدْلَهِمَّاتِ ثِيَابِهَا
items.en: nor could it dress you its murky clothes.
items.ur: اور اس زمانے کے تاریک لباسوں میں ملبوس نہ ہوئے

items.ar: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ مِنْ دَعَاۤئِمِ الدِّيْنِ
items.en: I also bear witness that you are one of the mainstays of the religion
items.ur: اور میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ آپ دین کے ستونوں

items.en: and the supports of the faithful believers.
items.ur: اور مومنوں کے ارکان میں سے ہیں

items.ar: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ الْاِمَامُ الْبَرُّ التَّقِيُّ
items.en: I also bear witness that you are the Godfearing, pious,
items.ur: اور میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ آپ وہ امام ہیں جو نیک کردار، پرہیز گار،

items.en: pleased, immaculate,
guide, and well-guided Imam.
items.ur: پسندیدہ، پاکیزہ، ہدایت دینے والے اور ہدایت پائے ہوئے ہیں

items.ar: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ الْاَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ التَّقْوٰى
items.en: And (I bear witness) that the Imams from your progeny are the spokesmen of piety,
the signs of guidance,
items.ur: وہ پرہیز گاری کے مظہر، ہدایت کے نشان،

items.en: the firmest handle (of Islam),
and the decisive Argument against the inhabitants of the world.
items.ur: مضبوط و محکم رسی اور دنیا والوں پر خدا کی دلیل و حجت ہیں

items.en: And I call Allah, His angels,
items.ur: اور میں گواہ بناتا ہوں خدا کو، اس کے فرشتوں کو،

items.en: His Prophets, and His Messenger
items.ur: اور اس کے نبیوں اور رسولوں کو

items.en: to witness for me that I believe in you all and in your Return,
items.ur: اور آپ کی واپسی کا یقین رکھتا ہوں

items.ar: مُوْقِنٌ بِشَرَاۤئِعِ دِيْنِيْ وَ خَوَاتِيْمِ عَمَلِيْ
items.en: I have full confidence in the laws of my religion and in the seals of my deeds,
items.ur: اور اپنے عمل کے انجام کے ساتھ

items.en: my heart is at peace with you all,
and all my affairs are based on your commands.
items.ur: ہم آہنگ ہے اور میرا کام آپ کی پیروی ہے

items.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ عَلٰىۤ اَرْوَاحِكُمْ
items.en: May Allah’s benedictions be on your souls,
items.ur: خدا کی رحمتیں ہوں آپ پر اور آپ کی روحوں پر

items.ar: وَ عَلٰىۤ اَجْسَادِكُمْ وَ عَلٰىۤ اَجْسَامِكُمْ
items.en: your bodies, your forms,
items.ur: اور آپ کے پاک وجودوں پر اور اجسامِ مطہر پر

items.ar: وَ عَلٰىۤ شَاهِدِكُمْ وَ عَلٰىۤ غَاۤئِبِكُمْ
items.en: the present and the absent from you,
items.ur: اور رحمت ہو آپ میں سے حاضر پر اور غائب پر

items.ar: وَ عَلٰى ظَاهِرِكُمْ وَ عَلٰى بَاطِنِكُمْ۔
items.en: and the apparent and the invisible from you.
items.ur: اور رحمت ہو آپ کے ظاہر و عیاں اور آپ کے باطن پر۔

items.head: Ziyarat Hazrat Ali Akbar (a.s.)
items.tl: ASSALAMO ALAIKA YABNA RASOOLILLAHE ASSALAMO ALAIKA YABNA NABIYYILLAHE ASSALAMO ALAIKA YABNA AMEERIL MO'MENEENA ASSALAMO ALAIKA YABNAL HUSAINISH SHAHEEDE ASSALAMO ALAIKA AYYOHASH SHAHEEDO WABNUSH SHAHEED ASSALAMO ALAIKA AYYOHAL MAZLOOMO WABNUL MAZLOOMO L'ANALLAHO UMMATAN QATALATKA WA L'ANALLAHO UMMATAN ZALAMATKA WA L'ANALLAHO UMMATAN SAME'AT BEZALEKA FARAZEYAT BEHI.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے رسول خدا (ص) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ نَبِيِّ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the Prophet of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے نبی خدا (ص) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the commander of the faithful.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے امیر المؤمنین (ع) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ الشَّهِيْدِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of al-Husayn the martyr.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے حسین (ع) شہید کے فرزند

items.en: Peace be upon you, O martyr.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر کہ آپ شہید ہیں اور شہید کے فرزند ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْمَظْلُوْمُ وَ ابْنُ الْمَظْلُوْمِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O wronged and harassed and the son of the wrong and harassed.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو کہ آپ مظلوم اور مظلوم کے فرزند ہیں

items.en: Curse of Allah be on those who killed you.
items.ur: خدا کی لعنت ہو ان پر جنہوں نے آپ کو قتل کیا

items.en: Curse of Allah be on those who persecuted you.
items.ur: اور خدا کی لعنت ہو ان پر جنہوں نے آپ پر ظلم کیا

items.ar: وَ لَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ۔
items.en: Curse of Allah be on those who heard this even but rested satisfied.
items.ur: اور خدا کی لعنت ہو ان پر جنہوں نے یہ واقعہ سنا تو اس پر خوش ہوئے

items.head: Ziyarat e Shohada e Karbala (a.s.)
items.tl: ASSALAAMU ALAYKUM YA AWLIYAA-ALLAHI WA AHIBAA-AH. ASSALAAMU ALAYKUM YA ASFIYAA-ALLAHI WA AWIDDAA-AH. ASSALAAMU ALAYKUM YA ANSAARA DINILLAH. ASSALAAMU ALYKUM YA ANSAARA RASULILLAH. ASSALAMU ALYKUM YA ANSAARA AMIRIL MUMININ. ASSALAMU ALYKUM YA ANSAARA FATIMATA SAYEEDATI NISSAIL AALAMIN. ASSALAMU ALAYKUM YA ANSAARA ABI-MUHAMMADINIL HASSAN-IBNI ALIYYINIZ-ZAKIYIN NAASIHIL AMIN. ASSALAAMU ALAYKUM YA ANSAARA ABI-ABDILLAH BI ABI ANTUM WA UMMI, TIBTUM WA TAABATIL ARZULLATI FIHA DUFINTUM WA FUZTUNM FAWZAN AZIIMA, FAYA LAITANI KUNTU MA-AKUM FA-AFUZU MA-AKUM.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ اللّٰهِ وَ اَحِبَّاۤءَهُ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O friends and dears of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے اولیاء اللہ اور اے اللہ کے پیارو

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَصْفِيَاۤءَ اللّٰهِ وَ اَوِدَّاۤءَهُ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O choice of Allah and sincerely attached to Him.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے خدا کے برگزیدہ لوگو اور اس کے دوستو

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Allah’s religion.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے دین خدا کی مدد کرنے والو

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Messenger of Allah.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے رسول خدا (ص) کی نصرت کرنے والو

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Commander of the Faithful.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے امیر المؤمنین (ع) کی امداد کرنے والو

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاۤءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Fatimah the doyenne of the women of this world.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے فاطمہ (س) کی حمایت کرنے والو جو تمام عورتوں کی سردار ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ اَبِيْ مُحَمَّدٍ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of ‘Ali, the saintly and sincere.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے ابو محمد حسن بن علی (ع) کے مددگارو کہ جو خدا کے ولی اور نصیحت کرنے والے ہیں

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَاۤ اَنْصَارَ اَبِيْ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu-'Abdullah.
items.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے ابو عبد اللہ حسین (ع) کی نصرت کرنے والو

items.en: My father and mother be sacrificed for you.
items.ur: میرے ماں باپ آپ پر قربان ہوں، آپ پاکیزہ ہیں

items.ar: طِبْتُمْ وَ طَابَتِ الْاَرْضُ الَّتِيْ [اَنْتُمْ‏] فِيْهَا دُفِنْتُمْ
items.en: Verily, pure be you and pure be the soil in which you were buried.
items.ur: اور وہ زمین بھی پاک ہے جس میں آپ مدفون ہیں

items.en: You attained great success.
items.ur: اور آپ نے بہت بڑی کامیابی حاصل کی

items.ar: فَيَا لَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ مَعَكُمْ فَاَفُوْزَ مَعَكُمْ ۔
items.en: Would that I were with you so that I could also share the accomplishment with you.
items.ur: اے کاش کہ میں بھی آپ کے ساتھ ہوتا تو یہ کامیابی حاصل کرتا۔

items.head: Ziyarat Hazrat Abbas (a.s.)
items.tl: AS SALAAMO ALAIKA YAA ABAL FAZLIL ABBAS IBNA AMEERIL MOMENEENA, AS SALAAMO ALAIKA YABNA SAYYEDIL WASIYEENA, AS SALAAMO ALAIKA YABNA AWWALAL QAWMI ISLAAMAN, WA AQDAMIHIM IMAANAN, WA AQWAMIHIM BI DEENILAAHI, WA AHWATIHIM ALAL ISLAMI, ASH HADO LAQAD NASAHTA LILLAHI WA LI RASOOLIHI WA LI AKHIKA FA NE'MAL AKHUL MUWASI, FA LA'NALLAHO UMMATAN QATALATKA, WA LA'NALLAHO UMMATAN ZALAMATKA, WA LA'NALLAHO UMMATAN ISTAHALLAT MINKAL MAHARIMA, WANTAHAKAT HURMATAL ISLAMI, FA NE'MAS SABIRUL MUJAAHIDUL MUHAAMIN NASIRO WAL AKHUD DAFEO 'AN AKHI HIL MUJEEBO ILA TA'ATI RABBIHIR RAGIBO FEEMA ZAHIDA FEEHI GHAIROHU MINAS SAWABIL JAZEELI, WAS SANAAIL JAMEELI, WA AL HAQAKALLAHU BI DARAJATI AABAAIKA FI JANNATIN NAEEMI.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَاۤ اَبَا الْفَضْلِ الْعَبَّاسَ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Abul Fazl al-Abbas,
son of the Commander of the Faithful.
items.ur: آپ پر سلام ہو اے امیر المؤمنین (ع) کے فرزند

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ،
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the Chief of Successors.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ اَوَّلَ الْقَوْمِ اِسْلَامًا،
items.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the first of the people to embrace Islam,
the foremost of them in faith,
the firmest of them in the religion of Allah,
and the most protective of them over Islam.

items.ar: اَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلّٰهِ وَ لِرَسُوْلِهِ وَلِاَخِيْكَ
items.en: I bear witness that you were sincere to Allah, His Messenger, and your brother.
What an excellent, self-sacrificing brother you were!
May Allah curse the people who killed you,
and may Allah curse the people who oppressed you,

items.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً اِسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ الْمَحَارِمَ،
items.en: and may Allah curse the people who violated what is sacred regarding you,
and desecrated the sanctity of Islam.
What an excellent patient struggler,
the protector, the helper,
and the brother who defended his brother,
who responded to the obedience of his Lord,
who desired that which others were indifferent to—
of the great reward and the beautiful praise.

items.ar: وَاَلْحَقَكَ اللّٰهُ بِدَرَجَةِ اۤبَائِكَ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيْمِ۔
items.en: And may Allah join you with the rank of your forefathers in the Gardens of Bliss.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ وَابْنَ مَوْلَایَ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O my Master and son of my Master,
Peace be upon you, O stranger among strangers,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا سُلْطَانَ اَبَا الْحَسَنِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Sovereign, Abul Hasan,
Ali, son of Musa, al-Rida,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
Peace be upon you, O stranger among strangers,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُعِيْنَ الضُّعَفَاۤءِ وَالْفُقَرَاۤءِ،
items.en: Peace be upon you, O helper of the weak and the poor,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُغِيْثَ الشِّيْعَةِ وَالزُّوَّارِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O succor of the followers and the pilgrims
on the Day of Recompense,
Peace be upon you, O companion of the souls,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْمَدْفُوْنُ بِاَرْضِ طُوْسِ،
items.en: Peace be upon you, O the one buried in the land of Tus,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيَّ ابْنَ مُوْسَي الرِّضَا
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Ali, son of Musa, al-Rida,
and (all) greetings and praise,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلٰي اٰبَاۤئِكَ السَّبْعَةِ
items.en: Peace be upon you and upon your seven forefathers
and your four descendants,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ۔
items.en: Peace be upon you all, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Age,
Peace be upon you, O Vicegerent of the All-Merciful,
Peace be upon you, O partner of the Quran,
Peace be upon you, O our Master,
Master of the Era and the Time,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَ بَرَكَاتُہُ۔
items.en: Peace be upon you all, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ الْعَصْرِ وَالزَّمَانِ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Master of the Era and the Time,
(Grant us) safety, safety, safety,
from the tribulations of the time.
Peace be upon you, O Vicegerent of the All-Merciful,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اِمَامَ الْاِنْسِ وَالْجَآنِّ
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Imam of mankind and the jinn,
Peace be upon you, O manifestation of faith,
Peace be upon you, O partner of the Quran,
Peace be upon you, O the decisive proof,

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اِمَامَ زَمَانِنَا هٰذَا
items.en: Peace be upon you, O Imam of this time of ours,
May Allah hasten your relief (reappearance),

items.ar: وَ سَهَّلَ اللهُ مَخْرَجَكَ وَ ظُهُوْرَكَ
items.en: and may Allah make easy your coming and your manifestation.

items.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.en: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰي مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad.

faraj-ilahi.name: Dua e Faraj (Ilahi Azumal Bala)

items.note: The Supplication of the Patron of the Matter; i.e. Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.):
In his book of al-Balad al-Amin, Shaykh al-Kaf’ami has mentioned that Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.) taught this supplicatory prayer to a prisoner who was then set free:

items.en: O my God, ordeal has become immeasurable.
The hidden has become exposed.
The covered has been disclosed.
Hope has been cut off.
The earth has become narrow (despite its vastness).
The sky has. been prevented (from giving its blessings),
(among all that) Your help is only sought,
to You is the complaint,

items.ar: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَ الرَّخَاۤءِ
items.en: and upon You is the reliance in hardships and leisure.

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
items.en: O Allah, (please do) Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

items.ar: اُوْلِيْ الْاَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَاعَتَهُمْ
items.en: the men in authority the obedience to whom has been made obligatory upon us by You
and whose (special) rank has been made known for us by You;
so, (please do) relieve our ordeals in the name of them,
a relief that is as immediate and forthcoming
as the twinkling of an eye or even closer.
O Muhammad! O 'Ali!
O 'Ali! O Muhammad!
(please do) save me, for you both do save,
and support me, for you both do support.
O our master, the Patron of the Age,
(I beseech you for) relief! (I beseech you for) relief! (I beseech you for) relief!
(Please do) aid me! (Please do) aid me! (Please do) aid me!
This hour! This hour! This hour!
Immediately! Immediately! Immediately!
O (Allah the) most Merciful of all those who show mercy,
in the name of Muhammad and his Immaculate Household (respond).

faraj-ilahi.tl0: BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHEEM EELAAHI A'ZOMAL BALAAA-O WA BAREHAL KHAFAAA-O WAN KASHAFAL GHETAAA-O WAN QATA-A'R RAJAAA-O WA ZAAQATIL ARZO WA MONE-A'TIS SAMAAA-O WA ANTAL MUSTA-A'ANO WA ELAYKAL MUSHTAKAA, WA A'LAYKAL MO-A'WWALO FISH-SHIDDATE WAR RAKHAAA-E. ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIWN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN OLIL AMRIL LAZEENA FARAZTA A'LAYNAA TAA-A'TAHUM WA A'RRAFTANAA BE ZAALEKA MANZELATAHUM FA FARRIJ A'NNAA BE HAQQEHIM FARAJAN A-A'JELAN QAREEBAN KALAM-HIL BASARE AW HOWA AQRABO YAA MOHAMMADO YAA A'LIYYO YAA A'LIYYO YAA MOHAMMADO IKFEYAANI FA INNAKOMAA KAAFEYAANE WAN SORAANEE FA INNAKOMAA NAASERAANE YAA MAWLAANAA YAA SAAHEBAZ ZAMAANE. AL-GHAWS AL-GHAWS AL-GHAWS ADRIKNEE ADRIKNEE ADRIKNEE. AS-SAA-A'TE AS-SAA-A'TE AS-SAA-A'TE AL-A'JAL AL-A'JAL AL-A'JAL YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEEN. BE HAQQE MOHAMMADIWN WA AALEHIT TAAHEREEN.

faraj-kun.name: Dua e Faraj (Allahumma Kun Li Waliyyik)

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْحُجَّةِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ
items.en: O Allah, (please) be for Your representative, al-Hujjah the son of al-Hasan,
Your blessings be on him and on his forefathers,

items.ar: فِىْ هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَ فِىْ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
items.en: now and at all times,
protector, guardian,
leader, helper,
guide, and watcher
so that You shall allow him to prevail on Your lands willingly
and You shall make him enjoy it for a long time.

faraj-kun.tl0:
BISMILLAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM ALLAAHUMMA KUN LE-WALIYYEKAL HUJJATIBNIL HASANE

SALAWAATOKA A'LAYHE WA A'LAA AAABAA-EHI

FEE HAAZEHIS SAA-A'TE WA FEE KULLE SAA-A'TIN

WALIYYAWN WA HAAFEZAWN

WA QAA-EDAWN WA NAASERAWN

WA DALEELAWN WA A'YNAN

HATTAA TUSKENAHU ARZAKA TAW-A'N

WA TOMATTE-A'HU FEEHAA TAWEELAA.

kumayl.name: Dua e Kumayl

items.note: The Supplication of Kumayl ibn Ziyad al-Nakha’i, one of the close disciples of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen(a.s.).

This is one of the well-known supplications. Being the supplication of al-Khizr (a.s.)‘Allamah al-Majlisi says that it is the best of all supplications, which Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen(a.s.) taught to Kumayl, one of his best disciples. Recommendably, the supplication may be said during nights of mid-Sha’ban and every Thursday evening (i.e. the nights before Fridays). It is useful for protecting against the evil of enemies, for opening the gate of sustenance, and for forgiveness of sins. Both Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus have recorded this supplication; rather, I am quoting it from the book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid as follows:

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، الَّتِیْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things,

items.ar: وَ بِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِیْ قَھَرْتَ بِھَا كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
items.en: by Your strength, through which You dominate all things
toward which all things are humble,
and before which all things are lowly,

items.ar: وَ بِجَبَرُوْتِكَ الَّتِیْ غَلَبْتَ بِھَا كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
items.en: by Your invincibility through which You overwhelm all things,

items.ar: وَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا یَقُوْمُ لَھَا شَیْئٌ،
items.en: by Your might, which nothing can resist,

items.ar: وَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِیْ مَلَاَتْ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things,

items.ar: وَّ بِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِیْ عَلٰی كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: by Your authority, which towers over all thing,

items.ar: وَّ بِوَجْھِكَ الْبَاقِیْ بَعْدَ فَنَاۤءِ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

items.ar: وَّ بِاَسْمَاۤئِكَ الَّتِیْ مَلَاَتْ اَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: by Your Names, which have filled the areas of all things,

items.ar: وَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الَّذِیْ اَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things,

items.ar: وَّ بِنُوْرِ وَجْھِكَ الَّذِیْ اَضَاۤءَلَہٗ كُلُّ شَیْءٍ،
items.en: and by the light of Your Face, through which all things are illumined!
O Light! O All-holy!
O First of those who are first
and Last of those who are last!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَھْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْلِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُغَیِّرُ النِّعَمَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاۤءَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins, which hold back supplication!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَقْطَعُ الرَّجَاۤءَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins, which cut down hopes!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُنْزِلُ الْبَلَاۤءَ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ اَذْنَبْتُہٗ،
items.en: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed
and every mistake I have made!
O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,
I seek intercession from You with Yourself,

items.ar: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِجُوْدِكَ، اَنْ تُدْنِیَنِیْ مِنْ قُرْبِكَ،
items.en: and I ask You in the name of Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,
to provide me with gratitude toward You,
and to inspire me with Your remembrance.
O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive,
abased, and lowly man
to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me,
and to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment
and humble in every state.

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ وَ اَسْئَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُہٗ،
items.en: O Allah, I ask You the beseeching of one whose indigence is extreme,

items.ar: وَ اَنْزَلَ بِكَ عِنْدَ الشَّدَاۤئِدِ حَاجَتَہٗ،
items.en: who has stated to You in difficulties his need,
and whose desire for what is with You has become great.
O Allah, Your authority is tremendous,
Your place is lofty,
Your plan is hidden,
Your command is manifest,
Your domination is overwhelming,
Your power is unhindered

items.ar: وَ لَا یُمْكِنُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْ حُكُوْمَتِكَ.
items.en: and escape from Your governance is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,
nor concealer of my ugly acts,

items.ar: وَّ لَا لِشَیْئٍ مِّنْ عَمَلِیَ الْقَبِیْحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلًا غَیْرَكَ،
items.en: nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You.
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, and Yours is the praise!
I have wronged myself,
been audacious in my ignorance,

items.ar: وَ سَكَنْتُ اِلٰی قَدِیْمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِیْ وَمَنِّكَ عَلَیَّ.
items.en: and depended upon Your eternal good turn to me and Your favor toward me.
O Allah! O my Protector!
Too many are the ugly things You have concealed!

items.ar: وَ كَمْ مِنْ فَادِحٍ مِنَ الْبَلَاۤءِ اَقَلْتَہٗ،
items.en: Too many are the burdensome tribulations You have abolished!
Too many are the stumbles You have prevented!
Too many are the ordeals You have repelled!

items.ar: وَ كَمْ مِنْ ثَنَاۤءٍ جَمِیْلٍ لَسْتُ اَھْلًا لَہٗ نَشَرْتَہٗ.
items.en: Too much is the beautiful praise, of which I was unworthy, You have spread abroad!
O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,
my bad state is excessive,
my acts are inadequate,
my fetters have tied me down,

items.ar: وَ حَبَسَنِیْ عَنْ نَفْعِیْ بُعْدُ اَمَلِیْ،
items.en: my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain,
this world has seduced me with its delusions,
and my own soul and delay with its offences.
O my Master! So, I ask You by Your might
not to let my evil works and acts
veil my supplication from You,

items.ar: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنِیْ بِخَفِیِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَیْہِ مِنْ سِرِّیْ,
items.en: not to disgrace me through the hidden things You know of my secrets,

items.ar: وَ لَا تُعَاجِلْنِیْ بِالْعُقُوْبَۃِ عَلٰی مَا عَمِلْتُہٗ فِیْ خَلَوَاتِیْ،
items.en: not to hasten punishment to me for what I have done in private,
such as my evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds,
my continuous negligence, my ignorance,
my manifold passions, and my forgetfulness.
By Your might, O Allah,
be kind to me in all states,

items.ar: وَ عَلَیَّ فِیْ جَمِیْعِ الْاُمُوْرِ عَطُوْفًا.
items.en: and be gracious to me in all affairs!

items.ar: اِلٰھِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ مَنْ لِیْ غَیْرُكَ،
items.en: My God and Lord! Whom do I have save You
from whom to ask removal of my affliction
and regard for my affairs!
My God and Protector!
You put into effect through me a decree
in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

items.ar: وَ لَمْ اَحْتَرِسْ فِیْہِ مِنْ تَزْیِیْنِ عَدُوِّیْ،
items.en: and I did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.
So, he deluded me through my soul's caprice
and therein destiny favored him.

items.ar: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرٰی عَلَیَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُوْدِكَ،
items.en: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes
and disobeyed some of Your commands.

items.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَیَّ فِیْ جَمِیْعِ ذٰلِكَ،
items.en: So, Yours is the argument against me in all of that

items.ar: وَ لَا حُجَّۃَ لِیْ فِیْمَا جَرٰی عَلَیَّ فِیْہِ قَضَاۤؤُكَ،
items.en: and I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein
nor in what Your decree and Your test imposed upon me.
Now, I have come to You, My God,

items.ar: بَعْدَ تَقْصِیْرِیْ وَ اِسْرَافِیْ عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ،
items.en: after my shortcoming and immoderation toward myself,
proffering my excuse, regretful,
broken, apologizing,
asking forgiveness, repenting,
acknowledging, submissive, and confessing.

items.ar: لَا اَجِدُ مَفَرًّا مِمَّا كَانَ مِنِّیْ،
items.en: I find no place to flee from what I have shown

items.ar: وَ لَا مَفْزَعًا اَتَوَجَّہُ اِلَیْہِ فِیْ اَمْرِیْ
items.en: nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs
other than Your acceptance of my excuse

items.ar: وَ اِدْخَالِكَ اِیَّایَ فِیْ سَعَۃِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
items.en: and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.
O Allah, so accept my excuse,
have mercy upon the severity of my affliction,
and release me from the tightness of my fetters.
My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body,
the thinness of my skin,
and the frailty of my bones.
O You Who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me,

items.ar: وَ تَرْبِیَتِیْ وَ بِرِّیْ وَ تَغْذِیَتِیْ،
items.en: to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me, and to nourishment on me!
(please) Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity
and Your previous goodness to me!

items.ar: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ،
items.en: O my God, Master and Lord!

items.ar: اَ تُرَاكَ مُعَذِّبِیْ بِنَارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحِیْدِكَ
items.en: Will You torment me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity,

items.ar: وَ بَعْدَ مَا انْطَوٰی عَلَیْہِ قَلْبِیْ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
items.en: and after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,

items.ar: وَ لَھِجَ بِہٖ لِسَانِیْ مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ
items.en: the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned,
the love of You to which my mind has clung,

items.ar: وَ بَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِیْ وَ دُعَاۤئِـیْ
items.en: and the sincerity of my confession and my supplication,
humble before Your lordship?
Far be it from You!

items.ar: اَنْتَ اَكْرَمُ مِنْ اَنْ تُضَیِّعَ مَنْ رَبَّیْتَہٗ،
items.en: You are too generous to squander him whom You have nurtured,
banish him whom You have brought nigh,
drive away him whom You have given an abode,

items.ar: اَوْ تُسَلِّمَ اِلَی الْبَلۤاۤءِ مَنْ كَفَیْتَہٗ وَ رَحِمْتَہٗ،
items.en: or submit to tribulation him whom You have saved and shown mercy.

items.ar: وَ لَیْتَ شِعْرِیْ یَا سَیِّدِیْ وَ اِلٰھِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ.
items.en: Would that I knew, my Master, God and Protector,
will You give the Fire dominion over faces
fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,

items.ar: وَ عَلٰی اَلْسُنٍ نَطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِیْدِكَ صَادِقَۃً
items.en: over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity
and giving thanks to You in praise,

items.ar: وَ عَلٰی قُلُوْبٍ اِعْتَرَفَتْ بِاِلٰھِیَّتِكَ مُحَقِّقَۃً
items.en: over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

items.ar: وَ عَلٰی ضَمَاۤئِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ
items.en: over minds encompassing knowledge of You
until they have become humble,

items.ar: وَ عَلٰی جَوَارِحَ سَعَتْ اِلٰی اَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَاۤئِعَۃً
items.en: over organs speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience
and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission?
No such opinion is held of You
nor has such been reported - thanks to. Your bounty concerning You.
O All-generous! My Lord,

items.ar: وَ اَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِیْ عَنْ قَلِیْلٍ مِّنْ بَلَاۤءِ الدُّنْیَا وَ عُقُوْبَاتِھَا،
items.en: and You know my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,

items.ar: وَ مَا یَجْرِیْ فِیْھَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِہِ عَلٰی اَھْلِھَا،
items.en: and before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

items.ar: عَلٰی اَنَّ ذٰلِكَ بَلَاۤءٌ وَّ مَكْرُوْہٌ
items.en: even though it is a tribulation and ordeal
whose stay is short,
subsistence is little,
and period is fleeting.
How can I then endure the tribulations of the next world
and the great ordeals that occur within it?
It is a tribulation whose period is long,
station endures,
and sufferers are given no respite,

items.ar: لِاَنَّہٗ لَا یَكُوْنُ اِلَّا عَنْ غَضَبِكَ
items.en: since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath,
vengeance, and anger,

items.ar: وَ ھٰذَا مَا لَا تَقُوْمُ لَہُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ.
items.en: which cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.
O Master, so what about me?
For I am Your weak, lowly,
base, wretched, and miserable slave.

items.ar: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ.
items.en: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!
For which things would I complain to You?

items.ar: وَ لِمَا مِنْھَا اَضِجُّ وَ اَبْكِیْ
items.en: For which of them would I lament and weep?
For the pain and severity of chastisement?
Or for the length and period of tribulation?
So, if You take me to the punishments with Your enemies,

items.ar: وَ جَمَعْتَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَ اَھْلِ بَلَاۤئِكَ،
items.en: gather me with the people of Your tribulation,

items.ar: وَ فَرَّقْتَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَ اَحِبَّاۤئِكَ وَ اَوْلِیَاۤئِكَ،
items.en: and separate me from Your friends and saints,

items.ar: فَھَبْنِیْ یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ وَ رَبِّیْ.
items.en: then suppose—My God, Master, Protector, and Lord—
that I am able to endure Your chastisement,
how can I endure separation from You?

items.ar: وَ ھَبْنِیْ صَبَرْتُ عَلٰی حَرِّ نَارِكَ،
items.en: Suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,

items.ar: فَكَیْفَ اَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ اِلٰی كَرَامَتِكَ
items.en: how can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

items.ar: اَمْ كَیْفَ اَسْكُنُ فِیْ النَّارِ وَ رَجَاۤئـِیْ عَفْوُكَ
items.en: How can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

items.ar: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ اُقْسِمُ صَادِقًا
items.en: So by Your might, my Master and protector, I swear sincerely,
if You leave me with speech,

items.ar: لَاَضِجَّنَّ اِلَیْكَ بَیْنَ اَھْلِھَا ضَجِیْجَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ،
items.en: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful,
I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help,
I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft,

items.ar: وَ لَاُنَادِیَنَّكَ اَیْنَ كُنْتَ یَا وَلِیَّ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
items.en: and I will call to You: Where are You, O Sponsor of the believers,
O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,
O Aide of those who seek assistance,
O Friend of the hearts of the sincere,
O God of all the world's inhabitants!

items.ar: اَفَتُرَاكَ سُبْحَانَكَ یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ،
items.en: Will You— Glory be to You, My God, and Yours is the praised —
hear therein the voice of a slave surrendered to You,
imprisoned there because of his violations,
tasting the favor of its torment because of his disobedience,

items.ar: وَ حُبِسَ بَیْنَ اَطْبَاقِھَا بِجُرْمِہٖ وَ جَرِیْرَتِہٖ
items.en: and confined within its layers because of his sin and crime,

items.ar: وَ ھُوَ یَضِجُّ اِلَیْكَ ضَجِیْجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ  لِرَحْمَتِكَ،
items.en: while he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,
calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity,
and entreats You by Your lordship!

items.ar: یَا مَوْلَایَ، فَكَیْفَ یَبْقٰی فِی الْعَذَابِ
items.en: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement

items.ar: وَ ھُوَ یَرْجُوْ مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
items.en: while he has hope for Your previous clemency?
How should the Fire cause him pain

items.ar: وَ ھُوَ یَاْمُلُ فَضْلَكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ.
items.en: while he expects Your bounty and mercy?
How should its flames burn him

items.ar: وَ اَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَہٗ وَ تَرٰی مَكَانَہٗ.
items.en: while You hear his voice and see his place?
How should its groaning encompass him
while You know his weakness?
How should he be convulsed among its levels
while You know his sincerity?
How should its keepers torture him
while he calls out to You, O Lord?

items.ar: اَمْ كَیْفَ یَرْجُوْ فَضْلَكَ فِیْ عِتْقِہٖ مِنْھَا
items.en: How should he have hope for Your bounty in freeing him from it
while You abandon him therein?
Far be it from You[ That is not what is expected from You
nor what is well-known of Your bounty,

items.ar: وَ لَا مُشْبِہٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِہِ الْمُوَحِّدِیْنَ
items.en: nor is it similar to the goodness and kindness
You have shown to those who profess Your Unity.
So I declare with certainty

items.ar: لَوْلَا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِہٖ مِنْ تَعْذِیْبِ جَاحِدِیْكَ،
items.en: that were it not for what You have decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers

items.ar: وَ قَضَیْتَ بِہٖ مِنْ اِخْلَادِ مُعَانِدِیْكَ،
items.en: and what You have foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,

items.ar: لَجَعَلْتَ النَّارَ كُلَّھَا بَرْدًا وَّ سَلَامًا،
items.en: You would make the Fire, entirely, coolness and safety,

items.ar: وَ مَا كَانَ لِاَحَدٍ فِیْھَا مَقَرًّا وَّ لَا مُقَامًا،
items.en: and no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.
But You—holy are Your Names
have sworn that You will fill it with the unbelievers,
both jinn and men together,
and place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

items.ar: وَ اَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاۤؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِءًا،
items.en: Moreover, You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning
and were gracious through kindness as a favor:

items.ar: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا یَسْتَوُوْنَ.
items.en: “What? Is he who has been believer like him who has been ungodly? They are not equal.”
My God and Master!
So I ask You by the power You have apportioned,

items.ar: وَ بِالْقَضِیَّۃِ الَّتِیْ حَتَمْتَھَا وَ حَكَمْتَھَا،
items.en: the decision You have determined and imposed
and through which You have overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,

items.ar: اَنْ تَھَبَ لِیْ فِیْ ھٰذِہِ اللَّیْلَۃِ
items.en: that You forgive me in this night
and at this hour
every offence I have committed,
every sin I have performed,
every ugly thing I have concealed,
and every folly I have enacted
whether I have hidden, announced,
concealed, or manifested it,

items.ar: وَ كُلَّ سَیِّئَۃٍ اَمَرْتَ بِاِثْبَاتِھَا الْكِرَامَ الْكَاتِبِیْنَ،
items.en: every evil, act which You have commanded the Noble Writers to record,

items.ar: الَّذِیْنَ وَكَّلْتَھُمْ بِحِفْظِ مَا یَكُوْنُ مِنِّیْ،
items.en: those whom You have appointed to watch over what appears from me,

items.ar: وَ جَعَلْتَھُمْ شُھُوْدًا عَلَیَّ مَعَ جَوَارِحِیْ،
items.en: whom You have made, along with my organs, witness against me,

items.ar: وَ كُنْتَ اَنْتَ الرَّقِیْبَ عَلَیَّ مِنْ وَّرَاۤئِھِمْ
items.en: and You were the Watcher over me from behind them
and the Witness of what is hidden from them,
but through Your mercy You concealed it,
and through Your bounty You veiled it,

items.ar: وَ اَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّیْ مِنْ كُلِّ خَیْرٍ اَنْزَلْتَہٗ،
items.en: bestow upon me an abundant share of every good You send down,
kindness You confer,
goodness You unfold,
provision You spread out,
sin You forgive,
or error You cover.

items.ar: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
items.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

items.ar: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ وَمَالِكَ رِقِّی،ْ
items.en: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!
O  He in Whose hand is my forelock!
O He Who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He Who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

items.ar: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
items.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
I beseech You in the name of Your Truth, Holiness,
and the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,

items.ar: اَنْ تَجْعَلَ اَوْقَاتِیْ مِنَ اللَّیْلِ وَ النَّھَارِ،
items.en: to make my times in the night and the day
inhabited by Your remembrance,
and joined to Your service,
and to make my works acceptable to You,

items.ar: حَتّٰی تَكُوْنَ اَعْمَالِیْ وَ اَوْرَادِیْ كُلّھَا وِرْدًا وَّاحِدًا،
items.en: so that my works and litanies may all be a single litany,
and my occupation with Your service everlasting.

items.ar: یَا سَیِّدِیْ، یَا مَنْ عَلَیْہِ مُعَوَّلِیْ،
items.en: My Master! O He upon Whom I depend!
O He to Whom I complain about my states!

items.ar: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
items.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
Strengthen my organs in Your service,
fortify my ribs in determination,

items.ar: وَ ھَبْ لِیَ الْجِدَّ فِیْ خَشْیَتِكَ،
items.en: bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You
and continuity in my being joined to Your service

items.ar: حَتّٰی اَسْرَحَ اِلَیْكَ فِیْ مَیَادِیْنِ السَّابِقِیْنَ،
items.en: so that I may move easily toward You in the fields of the foremost,
hurry to You among the prominent,
desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous,
move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere,
fear You with the fear of those who have certitude,

items.ar: وَ اجْتَمِعَ فِیْ جَوَارِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ.
items.en: and gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

items.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ وَ مَنْ اَرَادَ نِیْ بِسُوْۤءٍ فَاَرِدْہُ،
items.en: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!
Whoever deceives me, deceive him!

items.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِیْ مِنْ اَحْسَنِ عَبِیْدِكَ نَصِیْبًا عِنْدَكَ،
items.en: Make me one of Your most excellent slaves in portion in Your decree,
the nearest of them in station to You,
and the most elected in proximity to You,

items.ar: فَاِنَّہٗ لَا یُنَالُ ذٰلِكَ اِلَّا بِفَضْلِكَ،
items.en: for that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.
Grant generously to me through Your munificence,
incline toward me with Your splendor,
protect me with Your mercy,
make my tongue remember You without ceasing
and my heart enthralled by Your love,
be gracious to me by answering me favorably,
nullify my slips,
and forgive my lapses!
For You have decreed Your worship for Your servants,
commanded them to supplicate You,
and assured them that they would be answered.
So, toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face,

items.ar: وَ اِلَیْكَ یَا رَبِّ مَدَدْتُ یَدِیْ،
items.en: and toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.
So, in the name of Your might, respond to my supplication,
make me attain my desires,

items.ar: وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رَجَاۤئـِیْ،
items.en: do not severe my hoping for Your favours

items.ar: وَاكْفِنِیْ شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئـِیْ،
items.en: and spare me the evil of my enemies from among jinn and men!
O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

items.ar: اِغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَا یَمْلِكُ اِلَّا الدُّعَاۤءَ،
items.en: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication
For You do what you will.
O He whose Name is a remedy,
Whose remembrance is a cure,
And whose obedience is wealth!
Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is tears!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!
O Knower who was never taught!

items.ar: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
items.en: Bless Muhammad and Muhammad's household!
And do with me what is worthy of You!
May Allah bless His messenger
and the holy Imams of his household
And give them abundant peace!

YAA SAYYEDI YAA MAN A'LAYHE MOA'WWALI YAA MAN ELAYHE SHAKAWTO AHWAALI YAA RABBE YAA RABBE YAA RABBE QAWWE A'LAA KHIDMATEKA JAWAAREHI WASHDUD A'LAL A'ZEEMATE JAWAANEHI WA HAB LEYAL JIDDA FEE KHASHYATEKA WADDAWAAMA FIL ITTESAALE BE KHIDMATEKA HATTAA ASRAHA ELAYKA FEE MAYAADEENIS SAABE-QEENA WA USRE-A' ELAYKA FIL BAAREZEENA WA ASH-TAAQA ELA QURBEKA FIL MUSHATAAQEENA WA ADNO-A MINKA DONUWWAL MUKHLESEENA WA AKHAAFAKA MAKHAAFATAL MOOQENEENA WAJTAMEA' FEE JAWAAREKA MA-A'L MOMENEENA ALLAAHUMMA WAMAN ARAADANI BE SOOO-IN FA ARIDHO WAMAN KAADANI FAKIDHO WAJA'LNI MIN AH'SANE A'BEE DEKA NASEE-BAN I'NDAKA WA AQRABEHIM MANZELATAM MINKA WA AKHASSEHIM ZULFATAN LADAYKA FA INNAHU LAA YANAALO ZAALEKA ILLA BEFAZLEKA WA JUDLI BEJOODEKA WA'TIF A'LAYYA BE MAJDEKA WAHFAZNI BE RAHMATEKA WAJ-A'L LESAANI BE ZIKREKA LAHEJAN WA QALBI BE HUBBEKA MUTAYYAMAN WA MUNNA A'LAYYA BE HUSNE EJAABATEKA WA AQILNI A'SRATI WAGHFIR ZALLATI FA INNAKA QAZAYTA A'LAA E'BAADEKA BE E'BAADATEKA WA AMARTAHUM BE DOA'AEKA WA ZAMINTA LAHOMUL EJAABATA FA ELAYKA YAA RABBE NASABTO WAJHI WA ELAYKA YAA RABBE MADADTO YADI FABE I'ZZATEKAS TAJIB LI DOA'AEI WA BALLIGHNI MONAAYA WA LAA TAQTA-A' MIN FAZLEKA RAJAAA-EI WAKFENI SHARRAL JINNE WAL INSE MIN AA'DAA-EI YAA SAREEA'R REZAA IGHFIR LEMAN LAA YAMLEKO ILLAD DOA'AA FA INNAKA FA-A'ALUN LEMAA TASHAAA-O YAA MAN ISMOHU DAWAAA-UN WA ZIKROHU SHEFAAA-UN WATA-A'TOHU GHENAN IRHAM MAN RAASO MAALEHIR RAJAAA-O WA SELAA-HOHUL BOKAAA-O YAA SAABEGHAN NEA'ME YAA DAAFE A'N NEQAME YAA NOORAL MUSTAWHESHEENA FIZZOLAME YAA A'ALEMAN LAA YO-A'LLAMO SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WAF-A'L BI MAA ANTA AHLOHU WA SALLALLAAHO A'LAA RASOOLEHI WAL A-IMMATIL MAYAAMEENA MIN AALEHI WA SALLAMA TASLEEMAN KASEERAA.

kisa.name: Hadees e Kisa

items.note: Hadeeth-e-Kisa is that gracious description, which is a Tradition too and a description and an event too, a description of excellences also and a reason of prosperity too - Who is among the believers not aware of the words or meaning of this gracious Hadeeth, this is the Hadeeth healing the ill, the medium of fulfilling the desires of the desirous, supporting the helpless person engulfed in calamities - Just as this fact has also been mentioned itself in it that, by reciting it the mercy of Allah descends, and angels come and are busy asking for forgiveness - If recited before an owner of insight then better and spacious conditions are attained, if recited before a needy person then his needs are fulfilled, and since hundreds of years the believers are deriving the benefits of it's graces, and why should it not be? It is a recital of the owners of infallibility and purity, a mention of Siddiqa-e-Tahera (s.a.w.a), a commentary of the Holy Qur'an, an event of the assembly of Allah's lights, amazement and hope for the dwellers of Allah's throne and the greatness and excellence for the best of humans and it's pure roots - If, in presence of these specialities if grace, prosperity and mercy does not descend then when?

items.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

items.ar: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْاَنْصَارِيْ اَنَّهُ قَالَ:عَنْ فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّهْرَاۤءِ عَلَیْهَا السَّلَامُ بِنْتِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّی اللّٰهُ عَلَیْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ فَاطِمَۃَ اَنَّهَا قَالَتْ
items.en: Fatimatuz-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet (s), peace be on them, is to have thus related ( an event ) :

items.ar: دَخَلَ عَلَیَّ اَبِیْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ فِیْ بَعْضِ الْأَیَّامِ فَقَالَ:
items.en: My father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, came to my house one day and said to me:
Peace be on you, Fatimah
I replied : "And upon you be peace"

items.ar: قَالَ: اِنِّیْۤ اَجِدُ فِیْ بَدَنِیْ ضُعْفًا
items.en: Then he said : "I feel weakness in my body"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: لَهٗ اُعِیْذُكَ بِاللّٰهِ یٰاۤ اَبَتَاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ
items.en: I said : "May Allah protect you from weakness, father"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: یَا فَاطِمَۃُ اِیْتِیْنِیْ بِالْكِسَاۤءِ الْیَمَانِیْ فَغَطِّیْنِیْ بِهٖ
items.en: He said : "Fatimah, please bring the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it"
So, I brought the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it.

items.ar: وَ صِرْتُ اَنْظُرُ اِلَیْهِ وَ اِذَا وَجْهُهٗ یَتَلَاْ لَؤُ
items.en: Then, I looked at him and saw that his face was shining

items.ar: كَاَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِیْ لَیْلَۃِ تَمَامِهٖ وَ كَمَالِهٖ (صلوات)
items.en: like a full moon with its glory and splendor

items.ar: فَمَا كَانَتْ اِلَّا سَاعَۃً وَّ اِذَا بِوَلَدِیَ الْحَسَنِ قَدْ اَقْبَلَ
items.en: After a while, my son Hasan came in

items.ar: وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَاۤ اُمَّاهُ
items.en: and said : "Peace be on you, mother"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَا قُرَّۃَ عَیْنِیْ وَ ثَمَرَۃَ فُؤَادِیْ
items.en: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"

items.ar: فَقَالَ یَاۤ اُمَّاهُ اِنِّۤیْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَاۤئِحَۃً طَیِّبَۃً
items.en: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet

items.ar: كَاَنَّهَا رَاۤئِحَۃُ جَدِّیْ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
items.en: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ اِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather is underneath the cloak"

items.ar: فَاَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاۤءِ وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا جَدَّاهُ یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Hasan went near the cloak and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah;

items.ar: اَتَاْذَنُ لِیْ اَنْ اَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: May I enter the cloak with you?"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَا وَلَدِیْ وَ یَا صَاحِبَ حَوْضِیْ
items.en: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son and the master of my fountain (Kauthar),
you are given the permission to enter"
So, Hasan entered the cloak with him

items.ar: فَمَا كَانَتْ اِلَّا سَاعَۃً وَّ اِذَا بِوَلِدِیَ الْحُسَیْنِ قَدْ اَقْبَلَ وَ قَالَ
items.en: After a while, my Husain came in and said :
Peace be on you, mother

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَا وَلَدِیْ وَ یَا قُرَّۃَ عَیْنِیْ وَ ثَمَرَۃَ فُؤَادِیْ
items.en: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: لِیْ یَاۤ اُمَّاهُ اِنِّۤیْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَاۤئِحَۃً طَیِّبَۃً
items.en: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet

items.ar: كَاَنَّهَا رَاۤئِحَۃُ جَدِّیْ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّی اللّٰهُ عَلَیْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ
items.en: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ اِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَ اَخَاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather and your brother are underneath the cloak"
Husain stepped towards the cloak

items.ar: وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا جَدَّاهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَنِ اخْتَارَهُ اللّٰهُ
items.en: and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Chosen of Allah;

items.ar: اَتَاْذَنُ لِیْۤ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمَا  تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: May I enter the cloak with you?"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَا وَلَدِیْ
items.en: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son

items.ar: وَ یَا شَافِعَ اُمَّتِیْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
items.en: and interceder of my followers, you are given the permission to enter"
So, Husain entered the cloak with them.

items.ar: فَاَقْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذَالِكَ اَبُوْالْحَسَنِ عَلِیُّ بْنُ اَبِیْطَالِبٍ
items.en: After a while, Abul Hasan, Ali bin Abi Talib came in

items.ar: وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: and said : "Peace be on you, O daughter of the Prophet (s) of Allah"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَاۤ اَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَ یَاۤ اَمِیْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ،
items.en: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O father of Hasan, and the Commander of the faithful"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: یَا فَاطِمَۃُ اِنِّیْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَاۤئِحَۃً طَیِّبَۃً
items.en: He then said : "O Fatima! I smell a fragrance so sweet and so pure

items.ar: كَاَنَّهَا رَاۤئِحَۃُ اَخِیْ وَابْنِ عَمِّیْ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
items.en: as that of my brother and my cousin, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

items.ar: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَ لَدَیْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: I replied: "Yes. He is underneath the cloak with your two sons"
So, Ali went near the cloak

items.ar: وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ
items.en: and said : "Peace be on you, Prophet (s) of Allah;

items.ar: اَتَاْذَنُ لِیْ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: May I enter the cloak with you?"

items.ar: قَالَ: لَهٗ وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَاۤ اَخِیْ وَ یَاۤ وَصِیِّیْ
items.en: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my brother, my successor,

items.ar: وَ خَلِیْفَتِیْ وَ صَاحِبَ لِوَاۤئـِیْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
items.en: my successor, and my standard bearer, you are given the permission to enter"
So, Ali entered the cloak with them.
Then I stepped forward

items.ar: وَ قُلْتُ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَاۤ اَبَتَاهُ یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ
items.en: and said : "Peace be on you, my father, O Prophet (s) of Allah;

items.ar: اَتَأذَنُ لِیْ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: May I enter the cloak with you?"

items.ar: قَالَ: وَ عَلَیْكِ السَّلَامُ یَا بِنْتِیْ وَ یَا بِضْعَتِیْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكِ
items.en: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my daughter, O part of myself; you are given the permission to enter"
So, I entered the cloak with them.

items.ar: فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنَا جَمِیْعًا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ اَخَذَ اَبِیْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ بِطَرَفِیْ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: Getting together underneath the cloak, my father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, held the two ends of the cloak

items.ar: وَ اَوْمَئَ بِیَدِهِ الْیُمْنٰی اِلَی السَّمَاۤءِ وَ قَالَ:
items.en: and raised his right hand towards the heavens and prayed :

items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰؤُلَاۤءِ اَهْلُ بَیْتِیْ وَ خَاصَّتِیْ وَ حَامَّتِیْ
items.en: O Allah, these are the people of my Household (Ahlul-Bayt). They are my confidants and my supporters.
Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood.
Whoever hurts them, hurts me too.
Whoever displeases them, displeases me too.
I am at war with those who are at war with them.
I am at peace with those who are at peace with them.
I am the enemy of their enemies
and I am the friend of their friends.
They are from me and I am from them.

items.ar: فَاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ
items.en: O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings, Benevolence,
Forgiveness and Your pleasure upon me and upon them.

items.ar: وَ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ اَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَ طَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِیْرًا۔ (صلوات)
items.en: And keep them away from impurity (and flaws) and keep them thoroughly purified"
Then the Lord, Almighty Allah said :

items.ar: یَا مَلَاۤئِكَتِیْ وَ یَا سُكَّانَ سَمَوَاتِیْ
items.en: O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,

items.ar: اِنِّیْ مَا خَلَقْتُ سَمَاۤءً مَّبْنِیَّۃً وَّلَا اَرْضًا مَّدْحِیَّۃً  وَّلَا قَمَرًا مُّنِیْرً
items.en: verily, I have not created the erected Sky, the stretched earth, the illuminated moon,

items.ar: وَّلَا شَمْسًا مُّضِیْۤئَۃً وَّلَا فَلَكًا یَّدُوْرُ وَلَا  بَحْرًا یَّجْرِیْ وَلَا فُلْكًا یَّسِرِیْۤ
items.en: the bright sun, the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,

items.ar: اِلَّا فِیْ مَحَبَّۃِ هٰؤُلَاۤءِ الْخَمْسَۃِ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: but for the love of these Five underneath the cloak"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: الْاَمِیْنُ جَبْرَائِیْلُ: یَا رَبِّ وَ مَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ
items.en: Gabriel, the trusted angel, asked : "Who are under the cloak?"
The Almighty answered :

items.ar: هُمْ اَهْلُ بَیْتِ النُّبُوَّۃِ وَ مَعْدِنُ الرِّسَالَۃِ
items.en: They are the Household of the Prophet (s) and the assets of Prophet hood.

items.ar: هُمْ فَاطِمَۃُ وَ اَبُوْهَا وَ بَعْلُهَا وَ بَنُوْهَا (صلوات)
items.en: They are : Fatimah, her father, her husband and her two sons"

items.ar: فَقَالَ جَبْرَائِیْلُ یَا رَبِّ اَتَاْذَنُ لِیْۤ اَنْ اَهْبِطَ اِلَی الْاَرْضِ
items.en: Gabriel said : "O Lord, May I fly to earth
to be the sixth of them?"

items.ar: فَقَالَ اللّٰهُ: نَعَمْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
items.en: Allah replied: "Yes. You are given the permission"

items.ar: فَهَبَطَ الْاَمِیْنُ جَبْرَائِیْلُ وَ قَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ
items.en: Gabriel, the trusted, landed near them and said : "Peace be on you, O Prophet (s) of Allah.

items.ar: الْعَلِیُّ الْاَعْلٰی یُقْرِئُكَ السَّلَامُ وَ یَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِیَّۃِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ
items.en: The All-Highest conveys His peace on you and His greetings

items.ar: وَ یَقُوْلُ لَكَ: وَ عِزَّتِیْ وَ جَلَالِیْ
items.en: and says: "By My Honor and Glory, O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,
verily, I have not created the erected Sky,

items.ar: وَّلَا اَرْضًا مَّدْحِیَّۃً وَّلَا قَمَرًا مُّنِیْرًا وَّلَا شَمْسًا مُّضِیْۤئَۃً
items.en: the stretched earth, the illuminated moon, the bright sun,

items.ar: وَّلَا فَلَكًا یَّدُوْرُ وَلَا بَحْرًا یَّجْرِیْ وَلَا فُلْكًا یَّسْرِیْ
items.en: the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,
but for your sake and love"

items.ar: وَ قَدْ اَذِنَ لِیْۤ اَنْ اَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ
items.en: and Allah has given me permission to enter the cloak with you.

items.ar: فَهَلْ تَاْذَنُ لِیْ یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ
items.en: May I join you, O Prophet (s) of Allah?"

items.ar: فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ وَ عَلَیْكَ السَّلَامُ یَاۤ اَمِیْنَ وَحْیِ اللّٰهِ
items.en: The Prophet (s) replied : "And peace be on you, O trusted bearer of Allah's Revelations!
you are granted the permission"
So, Gabriel entered the cloak with us

items.ar: فَقَالَ: لِاَبِیْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ اَوْحیٰۤ اِلَیْكُمْ یَقُوْلُ
items.en: and said to my father : Allah sends His Revelations to you;

items.ar: اِنَّمَا یُرِیْدُ اللّٰهُ لِیُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ
items.en: Verily Allah's desire is to keep you away from impurity (and flaws),
O People of Household (Ahlul-Bayt) and keep you thoroughly purified"

items.ar: فَقَالَ: عَلِیٌّ  لِاَبِیْ: یَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ اَخْبِرْنِیْ مَا لِجُلُوْ سِنَا
items.en: Then Ali said to my father : "O Prophet (s) of Allah, tell me

items.ar: هٰذَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاۤءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَاللّٰهِ
items.en: what significance has Allah given for getting together underneath this cloak ?"

items.ar: فَقَالَ النَّبِیُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
items.en: The Prophet (s) replied :
By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet (s)
and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind.

items.ar: مَّا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هٰذَا فِیْ مَحْفِلٍ مِّنْ مَحَافِلِ
items.en: whenever and wherever an assembly

items.ar: اَهْلِ الْاَرْضِ وَ فِیْهِ جَمْعٌ مِّنْ شِیْعَتِنَا وَ مُحِبِّیْنَا
items.en: of our followers and friends mention this event,
Allah will bestow on them His Blessings and Mercy;

items.ar: وَ حَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلَاۤئِكَۃُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ اِلیٰ اَنْ یَّتَفَرَّقُوْا
items.en: angels will encircle them asking Allah the remission of their sins until the assembly disperses

items.ar: فَقَالَ عَلِیٌّ: اِذًا وَّ اللّٰهِ فُزْنَا وَ فَازَ شِیْعَتُنَا وَ رَبِّ الْكَعْبَۃِ
items.en: So Ali said : "Verily, by the Lord of Kabaa! we and our followers are the winners"

items.ar: فَقَالَ النَّبِیُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
items.en: Then my father replied :

items.ar: ثَانِیًا: یَا عَلِیُّ! وَالَّذِیْ بَعَثَنِیْ بِالْحَقِّ  نَبِیًّا
items.en: By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet
and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind,

items.ar: مَّا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هٰذَا فِیْ مَحْفِلٍ مِّنْ  مَحَافِلِ اَھْلِ الْاَرْضِ
items.en: whenever and wherever an assembly

items.ar: وَ فِیْهِ جَمْعٌ مِّنْ شِیْعَتِنَا وَ مُحِبِّیْنَا
items.en: our followers and friends mentions this event,

items.ar: وَ فِیْهِمْ مَهْمُوْمٌ اِلَّا وَ فَرَّجَ اللّٰهُ ھَمَّهٗ
items.en: there shall remain none grieved but Allah will remove his grief,

items.ar: وَلَا مَغْمُوْمٌ اِلَّا وَ كَشَفَ اللّٰهُ غَمَّهٗ
items.en: there shall remain none distressed but Allah will dispel his distress,

items.ar: وَلَا طَالِبُ حَاجَۃٍ اِلَّا وَ قَضَی اللّٰهُ حَاجَتَهٗ
items.en: there shall remain none wish-seeker but Allah will grant his wish."

items.ar: فَقَالَ عَلِیٌّ اِذًا وَّاللّٰهِ فُزْنَا وَ سُعِدْنَا وَ كَذَالِكَ شِیْعَتُنَا
items.en: `Ali, peace be upon him, said, "Then, we have won and attained pleasure. I swear it by Allah. So have our adherents;

items.ar: فَازُوْا وَ سُعِدُوْا فِی الدُّنْیَا  وَالْاٰخِرَۃِ وَ رَبِّ الْكَعْبَۃِ۔ (صلوات)
items.en: they have won and attained pleasure in this world and in the Hereafter. I swear it by the Lord of the Ka`bah."

FA QAALALLAAHO AZZA WA JALLA YAA MALAAA-EKATEE WA YAA SUKKAANA SAMAAWAATEE INNEE MAA KHALAQTO SAMAAA-A'M MABNIYYATAN WA LAA ARZAN MADHIYYATAN WALAA QAMARAM MONIRAN WA LAA SHAMSAN MOZEE-A'TAN, WALAA FALAKAN YADOORO WALAA BAHRAYN YAJRI WALAA FULKAN YASRI, ILLAA FEE MAHABBATE HAA-OOLAAA-IL KHAMSATIL LAZEENA HUM TAHTAL KESAAA-E. FA QAALAL AMEENO JIBRAEELO YAA RABBE WA MAN TAHTAL KESAAA-E? FA QAALA AZZAWA JALLA HUM AHLO BAYTIN NOBUWWATE WA MA'DENUR RESAALATE HUM FAATEMATO WA ABOOHA WA BA'LOHAA WA BANOOHAA. (SALAWAAT) FA QAALA JABRAAA-EELO YAA RABBE ATA'ZANO LEE A'N AHBETA ELAL ARZE LE AKOONA MA-A'HUM SAADESAA. FA QAALALLAAHO NA-A'M QAD AZINTO LAKA. FAHABATAL AMEENO JABRAAA-EELO WA QAALAS SALAAMO A'LAYKA YAA RASOOLALLAAHE AL-A'LIYYUL A'ALAA YUQRE-OKAS SALAAMO WA YAKHUS-SOKA BITTAHIYYATE WAL IKRAAME WA YAQOOLO LAKA WA I'ZZATI WA JALAALI INNEE MAA KHALAQTO SAMAA-AN MABNIYYATAN WALAA ARZAN MADHIYYATAN WALAA QAMARAN MONEERAN WA LAA SHAMSAM MOZEE-ATAWN WA LAA FALAKAN YADOORO WALAA BAHRAN YAJRI WALAA FULKAN YASRI ILLAA LE AJLEKUM WA MAHABBATEKUM WA QAD AZENA LEE A'N ADKHOLA MA-A'KUM FA-HAL TA'ZANO LEE YAA RASOOLAL LAAHE. FA QAALA RASOOLAL LAAHE WA ALAYKAS SALAAMO YAA AMEENA WAHYIL LAAHE INNAHU NA-A'M QAD AZINTO LAKA FA DAKHALA JABRAAA-EELO MA-A'NA TAHTAL KESAAA-E. (SALAWAAT) FA QAALA LE ABI INNAL LAAHA QAD AWHAA ELAYKUM YAQOOLO INNAMAA YOREEDUL LAAHO LE YUZHEBA A'NKOMUR RIJSA AHLAL BAYTE WA YOTAHHERAKUM TATHEERAA. FA QAALA A'LIYYUN LE ABI YAA RASOOLAL LAAHE AKHBIRNI MAA LEJOLOOSENA HAAZA TAHTAL KESAAA-E MENAL FAZLE I'NDAL LAAHE. FA QAALAN NABIYYO WAL-LAZI BA-A'SANI BIL HAQQE NABBIYYAWN WASTAFAANI BIR RESAALATE NAJIYYAM MAA ZOKERA KHABARONA HAAZA FEE MAHFELIM MIN MAHAAFELE AHLIL ARZE, WA FEEHE JAM-U'M MIN SHEEA'TENAA WA MOHIBBEENA ILLAA WA NAZALAT A'LAYHEMUR RAHMATO WA HAFFAT BEHEMUL MALAAA-EKATO WAS-TAGHFARAT LAHUM ELAA AYN YATAFARRAQOO. FA QAALA A'LIYYUN A'LAYHIS SALAAMO EZAN WALLAAHE FUZNAA WA FAAZA SHEEA'TONA WA RABBIL KAA'BATE FA QAALAN NABIYYO SAANEYAN YAA A'LIYYO WALLAZI BA-A'SANI BIL HAQQE NABIYYAN WASTAFAANI BIR-RESAALATE NAJIYYAM MAA ZOKERA KHABARONA HAAZA FEE MAHAAFELIM MIN MAHAAFELE AHLIL ARZE WA FEEHE JAM-U'M MIN SHEEA'TENA WA MOHIBBEENA WA FEEHIM MAHMOOMUN ILLAA WA FAR-RAJAL LAAHO HAMMAHU WALAA MAGHMOOMUN ILLAA WA KASHAFAL LAAHO GHAMMAHU WALAA TAALEBO HAAJATIN ILLAA WA QAZAL LAAHO HAAJATAHU. FA QAALA A'LIYYUN A'LAYHIS SALAAMO EZAN WALLAAHE FUZNA WA SOI'DNAA WA KAZAALEKA SHEEA'TONAA FAAZU WA SOE'DOO FID DUNYAA WAL AAKHERAH WA RABBIL KA'BATE.

mujeer.name: Dua e Mujeer

items.note: The Supplication of the Lenient Supporter.

This is a supplication of high eminence which is reported to have been brought by Jibreel for the Holy Prophet (pbuh) when he was engrossed in prayers in Maqam-e-Ibrahim. Kafa'ami has reported this supplication in Baladul Amin and in Misbah. It is mentioned by him that the reward for the one reciting it during 13th, 14th & 15th of the Holy month of Ramadan, is that his sins are forgiven even if they are in such plenty as the drops of rain water, leaves of trees or sand of a desert. It is also very effective for the cure of the sick, fulfillment of debts, acquisition of wealth and relief from sorrows.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ يَا ذَا الْعِزِّ وَ الْجَمَالِ
items.en: Glory be to You. O Lord of Honor and Grace, invoked for blessings.
O Lord of Might and Majesty, Glory be to You.
There is no god but You.
“Glory be to You. Verily, I have been a wrongdoer.”
“So We heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish
Thus We save believers.”

items.ar: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ،
items.en: Blessings of Allah be on our chief, Muhammad and his Household, one and all.
(All) praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
Sufficient for us is Allah. He is the Best Protector.

items.ar: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ العَظِيْمِ ۔
items.en: There is no power and no might except (with) Allah, the High, the Great.
